bio: The protagonist of the series, known for his tremendous power and friendly personality. He was originally sent to Earth as an infant with a mission to conquer it. In the newer Dragon Ball continuity, his parents instead sent him to Earth to survive the destruction of their planet by Frieza. Kakarot, now known as Son Goku, later became the prince consort of Mount Fry-pan, leader of the Z Fighters, and a foremost defender of Earth and Universe 7. He has saved them from destruction countless times, despite not considering himself a hero or savior.
